message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and so does the rest of the suite (18 pass, 0 fail).

`formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` always divided amounts by 100, so 500 JPY came out as `¥5.00`. I added a small zero-decimal currency set containing JPY. For those currencies, `formatMoney` now prints the amount as it is, so the receipt reads `Paid ¥500 by card`.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines and cart totals in JPY now also show whole yen. The old output for those was wrong in the same way. No other tests use yen.
